{{Quote|Saphrro! Wipe the data, we can't let it fall into enemy hands!|Commander Bol, ordering Commander Saphrro to erase the data on the location and strength of their troops|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Saphrro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. By [[3643 BBY]], he was a part of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during the [[Separatist War]], a conflict in which the group attempted to overthrow the Republic-backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Saphrro fought against [[Republic Army|Republic forces]] as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of one of the cells on the island of [[Avilatan]]. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a commander, he held a meeting to organize personnel transfers with two other Separatist cell commanders named [[Bol (Separatist)|Bol]] and [[Vyru]] at the [[Separatist Base|Separatist base]] on [[Mannett Point]], a small island off the coast of Avilatan. While the meeting was taking place, a newly recruited [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] known as [[Havoc Squad]] [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|infiltrated]] the base, [[Death/Legends|killed]] Saphrro and his fellow commanders, and took the information in their possession pertaining to their forces.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Saphrro, Vyru and Bol are priority-one targets, Sergeant. And recovering their data on separatist cell locations and manpower is too good an opportunity to pass up.|Lieutenant Aric Jorgan, ordering the Havoc Squad sergeant to eliminate Saphrro and the other commanders and claim their data|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Saphrro lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as the more widespread conflict, Saphrro was a member of a [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist Movement]] bent on overthrowing the Republic-backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in a struggle<ref name="TOR" /> that became known as the [[Separatist War]].<ref name="War">{{TORcite|type=message|Date night|Doc}} identified the war as the "Separatist War."</ref> He eventually attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and was in charge of one of the Separatist cells fighting against the [[Republic Army|Republic's armed forces]]<ref name="TOR" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> on [[Avilatan]], an island on Ord Mantell. That year, Saphrro went to meet with two other Separatist cell commanders at a [[Separatist Base|Separatist base]] on [[Mannett Point]], a small island off the coast of Avilatan. There, he and the other commanders, whose names were [[Bol (Separatist)|Bol]] and [[Vyru]], discussed how to coordinate their operations and the transfer of [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] between the various cells on the island. By that time, Saphrro had a reputation with the Separatists and was viewed by an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Dalern]] as one of the group's greatest heroes. Due to his and the other commanders' importance, the number of guards at the base was increased, and a [[Force-field generator|force field generator]] was installed to protect the meeting area.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Saphrro-TOR.png|thumb|left|220px|Saphrro holds up position near the computer.]]
While Saphrro and the other commanders met at the base, two members of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] [[Havoc Squad]]&mdash;[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zora]] and a newly recruited [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]]&mdash;[[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|infiltrated]] the heavily defended base in search of a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] that the Separatists had recently stolen. Upon disabling the [[Force field/Legends|force field]] and finding that the bomb was not being stored in the facility, the two [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] interrogated Dalern and learned that Saphrro and the other Separatist cell commanders were the reason for the increased security. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Aric Jorgan]]<ref name="TOR" /> of [[Ord Mantell Infantry Command]]<ref name="Jorgan">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Hit the Ground Running|Ord Mantell}}</ref> ordered the sergeant to obtain the commanders' data on Separatist [[Troop/Legends|troop]] strength and cell locations as well as to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] them all as priority-one targets. Bol and Vyru noticed the sergeant's approach, and Bol ordered Saphrro to wipe all of their data from their [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. Saphrro protested that they were only up against one [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] and prompted the other two commanders to fight back against the sergeant. However, Saphrro and the other two commanders were killed, and the sergeant was able to obtain their data since Saphrro had not deleted it.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It's because&hellip; well&hellip; Saphrro, Vyru and Bol are here. Three of our greatest heroes who lead us in our glorious&mdash;|Officer Dalern, speaking of the Commanders, before being cut off by Captain Zora|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Saphrro was a heavily built individual with [[Color/Legends|tan]]-colored skin and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. At the time of his death, he wore his brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in [[Double stripe|two stripes]] running from the top of his forehead to the back of his head, with a pair of thinner stripes running from front to back on each side of his head. As a cell commander, Saphrro had a large amount of knowledge of the Separatist cell's troop strengths and location on the island of Avilatan. Viewed by Officer Dalern as a great hero of the Separatist cause, Saphrro was also important enough to be involved in coordinating personnel transfers and operations with other cell commanders. He had enough experience with computers for Bol to order him to delete the data when confronted by the Republic sergeant. He was also proficient enough with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] to use it in combat against the sergeant.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
During his time as a Separatist cell commander, Saphrro wore red-and-gray-colored [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and utilized a [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shield]] that emitted a spherical blue-colored energy field when in use. He also carried a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|She's one soldier, Bol! Kill her!''"<br />"''He's just one man! Kill him!|Saphrro's dialogue for female troopers and male troopers|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Saphrro first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. He is featured in "Mannett Point," an early quest available on the planet Ord Mantell for players of the Trooper class. At the conclusion of the quest, the player is required to kill Saphrro, along with Bol and Vyru, the other two Separatist cell commanders with him at Mannett Point. After eliminating the commanders, the player must recover their data on the Separatist cells and forces for the island of Avilatan. Saphrro's line of dialogue telling his fellow commanders to kill the player differs depending on whether the player character is male or female.<ref name="TOR" />
